objects: declared attacking creature with a typed printed Dethrone instance
direct attacked player tied for the greatest active-player life total
events: one ordinary trigger per qualifying Dethrone instance
state_reads: complete active-player life totals at declaration
timing: qualification is frozen after all attackers have been declared
later life-total changes do not remove or create the trigger
choices: same-controller trigger ordering uses the ordinary trigger continuation
represented counter-replacement ordering remains scoped to the affected permanent controller
apnap: all Dethrone occurrences use the ordinary completed-declaration trigger batch
replacement_effects: counter quantity replacements resolve before the final +1/+1 counter commit
copy: granted or copied Dethrone requires separately trusted typed ability propagation
control_change: the trigger controller is frozen at creation while the same source object remains eligible after changing control
zone_change: a source that leaves and returns is a new logical object and receives no counter from the old trigger
source_leaves: a departed or phased-out source receives no counter

variants: active player tied for greatest life
attack against a planeswalker or Battle

implementation.component: quorune.attack_counter_triggers, quorune.attack_transition_engine_adapter, and the canonical counter-placement transaction

known_blockers: granted, copied, lost, and face-down Dethrone requires trusted typed ability propagation
put-onto-the-battlefield-attacking effects outside the completed declaration transition remain unsupported
trigger-doubling policies remain outside this bounded capability
aggregate counter placement and triggered abilities remain incomplete
